title: National Aeronautics and Space Administration: Phase 56N Verified Remediation Decision
summary: GAO lists both NASA recommendations Open. NASA reported evaluating use cases and retiring 38, but did not provide supporting documentation for the required plan; GAO also found the 2025 AI inventory missing start dates and required high-impact-use information. Phase 56N decision: Publish the exact two-action non-closure. The record materially separates reported agency activity from GAO-verified recommendation implementation.
key_findings: Status period: Recommendation 33 evidence through December 2024; recommendation 34 review in February 2026.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when GAO changes recommendation 33 or 34 status or NASA publishes documentation that GAO accepts as implementation evidence.
why_it_matters: The record adds exact implementation, non-closure, component, or portfolio evidence while keeping recommendation states and operational outcomes distinct.
ftfn_relevance: Separates recommendation implementation from performance, service, mission, safety, and readiness outcomes.
Keeps source owner, record identity, status period, limitation, and continuation rule attached.
evidence_limits: Open status and retired-use-case counts do not measure NASA AI performance, safety, mission benefit, cybersecurity effectiveness, or the GAO-25-108138 cyber recommendations.
Supporting documentation for the consistency-or-retirement plan, a complete 2025 AI inventory, recommendation closure, and system-level operating outcomes.
No entity ranking, composite, productivity, readiness, value, or causal claim is supported.
